notes.title: New Screenshots, and more to come!
notes.content:
Hello players!

I refreshed the screenshots of the game to reflect the current internal build of Wyrmhole. We have made significant progress since our previous Steam demo and we're pleased to say it's possible to play through the entire game now! We are working on a launch trailer and will have more info up on the store page alongside. We could really use your wishlist! It is hard for 2D RPGs to break through the algorithm and after personally playing through this past week with the team I am stoked to see everyone's builds and playthroughs. 

-Troy

notes.title: WYRMHOLE: Live Playthrough + Q/A with the Developers
notes.content: Bring your best questions! It's a live developer playthrough and Q/A session and we're headed deep into the tunnels of the game to show you pro strats and unnecessary lore tidbits.
